content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by VNSGU?
faq.answer: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Temporary Assistant Professor and Temporary Teaching Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications vary by post and include M.Com/MBA in HR, M.Sc. in Bioscience-Microbiology/Microbiology with Ph.D./NET/GSET, and MA English.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for VNSGU recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month, depending on the post and designation (Temporary Assistant Professor or Temporary Teaching Assistant).

faq.question: Q6. When are the walk-in interviews scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on different dates for different posts: July 30, 2026, for Commerce, July 31, 2026, for Biotechnology, and August 03, 2026, for Law.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the VNSGU located?
faq.answer: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University is located in Surat, Gujarat, with a pincode of 395007.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and more details?
faq.answer: The official notification and further details can be found on the VNSGU official website, and a direct link to the PDF is provided in the Important Links section.
